meta.test_rounds_used_for: none of training, early stopping or calibration (held-out test)
meta.window_rule: 16 consecutive aligned frames (~1.6 s at ~10 fps), non-overlapping, per round and point
meta.preprocessing: pp2 (55 valid subcarriers sorted by frequency), amplitude+phase

KNN.description: 4-link KNN (k=5, distance-weighted) on per-window time-averaged amplitude+phase (440-d, train-set standardised). Probabilities = distance-weighted vote of the 5 neighbours, so they are coarse.

GCN.description: Sample-graph GCN (structure ported from prior RSSI+GNN work), same features and k as 4-link KNN. Probabilities = softmax of logits.

ConcatMLP.description: Shared 2D-CNN encoder per link, 4 link features concatenated, MLP head, trained end-to-end. Probabilities = softmax of logits.

ConcatMLP-mask.description: ConcatMLP + random link masking during training (p=0.25). Probabilities = softmax of logits.
